# cloudminator_plans (Data Source)

Plan tiers and their entitlements.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudminator_plans" "all" {}

output "vm_limit_per_plan" {
  value = { for p in data.cloudminator_plans.all.plans : p.code => lookup(p.resource_limits, "vms", null) }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `plans` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))

<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `aggregate_limits` (Map of Number) Cross-resource caps, e.g. `vms.compute-units`, `vms.disk-gb`.
- `code` (String) Plan code.
- `default` (Boolean) The plan new organizations get.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `quotas` (Map of Number) Per-plan quota overrides.
- `resource_limits` (Map of Number) Max count per resource kind (`vms`, `buckets`, …), organization-wide.
